root_idea.summary: The root centers on a forceful springing or laying on of hands, yielding the Quranic sense of violent assault and related extensions involving forceful seizure.
root_idea.development: The reported foundational image is a horse rearing with its forelegs raised, whether in play or in mounting a female. From this image, the lexicon develops usages for assault, sexual mounting, extraction, and the forceful swelling or overflow of water.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form سَطَا rather than the Quranic imperfect morphology identity.

senses.definition: To spring or rush upon someone in a violent assault; to lay hands on, overpower, or attempt to subdue them.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction يَسْطُونَ بِـ, it describes a threatened violent attack against those reciting God's signs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mount sexually or have intercourse with a female.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the description of a stallion springing upon the female it covers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To extract retained stallion semen or a dead fetus from a female's womb.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the extraction of reproductive contents or a dead fetus from a female animal, and reported also in relation to a woman when a dead child is lodged in the womb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, to go at random, heedlessly, or headlong, without obeying guidance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A horse-specific usage describing uncontrolled or unguided movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, to move with a wide stride or to raise its tail while running.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The raised-tail behavior is described as approved in running.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of water, to become abundant or overflow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative application of the forceful-swelling image to water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take something with the hand or an extended hand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported figurative usage concerning grasping or taking by hand.
A usage equated with عَاقَبَ in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To compress or press a female.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately reported usage attributed to Abū Saʿīd.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To treat someone with hardness, severity, or rigor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III usage; the same derived verb is also reported with an opposite sense of gentleness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To treat someone with gentleness or tenderness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III usage reported as an opposite signification to harsh treatment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A springing or rush, an assault, or an impetuous attack, especially in war or battle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun or uninflected verbal noun denoting forceful attack or impetuosity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A reviling, beating, or punishment or chastisement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun or uninflected verbal noun used for an act or experience of punitive violence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who springs or rushes upon another or makes an assault; of a horse, one that attacks other horses.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The active participle may describe a horse that attacks with its forelegs; related horse descriptions include a wide stride or a raised tail while running.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stallion camel excited by lust and going from one group of camels to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized active-participle usage describing sexually driven movement among camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something tall or long, especially a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributive active-participle usage applied to camels and similar objects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Reaching or taking hold of something; of hands, extending to grasp.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the expression الأَيْدِي السَّوَاطِي, ‘hands that reach or take hold.’

lane_unit_coverage.note: Covers violent assault and the stallion's sexual mounting usage.
Covers extraction of semen or a dead fetus.
Covers heedless or headlong movement of a horse.
Covers a horse's wide stride or raised tail.
Covers tasting food and taking it by hand.
Covers the usage meaning to punish.
Covers the separately reported sense to compress a female.
Covers the noun's attack, reviling, beating, and punishment branches.
Covers the active participle for one who springs, rushes, or attacks.
Covers the horse-specific attacking and gait descriptions of the active participle.
Covers the sense tall or long when applied to camels.
